achievements.name: Rule Zero Badge
achievements.description: PEAK's secret-ending achievement. In a single expedition, collect all four Scout Gems across the biomes (Tenacity in SHORE, Initiative in ROOTS, Generosity in ALPINE, Ambition in GLOOM) and carry every one of them, without dropping any, all the way to THE PEAK. Bestow them on the Stone Scout to create Scout's Honor, commune with it, then climb down through NADIR and back up through the hidden gate to THE PEAK. Completing that sequence frees Scoutmaster Myers's soul and unlocks the badge.
